title: harf-promo/indexa
summary: The local context engine for AI. Summarizes every file, rolls folders up into whole-project context, and serves any AI tool (Claude Code, Cursor, local models) a ranked slice over CLI, web & MCP. Local-first, Apache-2.0.

title: adrianwedd/spark
summary: SPARK — a Claude-powered robot companion for a neurodivergent kid. Built on SunFounder PiCar-X + Raspberry Pi.

title: Anjanamb/hn-ml-trends
summary: Learning-first walkthrough of a stateful LangGraph agent for Hacker News trend tracking: local Ollama LLM + sentence-transformer embeddings + classical baselines, all evaluated against a hand-labelled gold set.

title: Optccopa/claudius_harness
summary: A model harness like claudecode or codex built in python, supports Anthropic natively and a large amount of models via OpenRouter and Ollama

title: Shelpuk-AI-Technology-Consulting/kitty-bridge
summary: Universal LLM bridge for AI agents. Use Claude Code with MiniMax, Codex with GLM, or Gemini CLI with OpenRouter — one command, any provider. Works with coding agents, OpenClaw, Hermes, and others.

title: repairman29/chump
summary: Self-hosted AI coding agent with persistent memory and bounded autonomy. Local-first, your keys, your data. Written in Rust.

title: omm-hippo/omm
summary: Open source Model Manager - hardware-aware install and recommend for local LLMs (GGUF).

title: styleio/ShikishaTerm
summary: Run Claude Code, Codex and Gemini side by side — and let them hand work to each other. Portable Windows terminal for AI CLIs.

title: RalfHermsen/x4-agent
summary: A local-LLM agent that plays X4: Foundations according to your own guidelines. The model plans, deterministic Python computes and executes. Built on SirNukes' Mod Support APIs.

title: Eshpelin/nurby
summary: AI camera monitoring platform that turns any existing IP camera into a context-aware sentry.

title: Yigtwxx/OracleX
summary: Open-source financial intelligence terminal for equities and digital assets. Real-time market data, LLM news analysis and a ChromaDB vector memory on a provider-agnostic reasoning layer — local via Ollama or any of 14 cloud providers. Next.js 14 and FastAPI.

title: ypollak2/llm-router
summary: Universal LLM router for AI coding tools. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot and more. Free-first fallback chain cuts costs 35-80%.

title: lachydotmcg/metis-orchestrator
summary: Local-first AI orchestration studio. Route every task to the best-suited model, local or cloud. BYO keys or OpenRouter, free.

title: Mike0165115321/Aetox
summary: Desktop AI agent for Windows — an architecture that expands what any model can do. Image/video OCR, offline speech transcription, an agent-driven browser, real .xlsx/.pptx/.docx output, MCP, and a delegated team of agents. Runs on your machine, with any provider.

title: Protremix/EvolvixOS
summary: EvolvixOS v9.2 — Open-source, self-hosted AI engineering platform. 44 tools, 81 models, 35K APIs. Triple-brain routing (Groq+Gemini+Kimi). Tencent Cloud + Octop + CubeSandbox + TIMSDK integrated.

title: langchain4j/langchain4j
summary: LangChain4j is an idiomatic, open-source Java library for building LLM-powered applications on the JVM. It offers a unified API over popular LLM providers and vector stores, and makes implementing tool calling (including MCP support), agents and RAG easy. It integrates seamlessly with enterprise Java frameworks like Quarkus and Spring Boot.

title: lidge-jun/opencodex
summary: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex & Claude Code — use any LLM (Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama…) with Codex CLI, App, SDK, and Claude Code

title: dillondevoe/agent-os
summary: A computer whose shell is an AI, not a desktop — boot straight into a local, offline AI brain. No cloud, no telemetry, nothing leaves unless you say so. Built on NixOS.

title: rouges78/GameStringer
summary: Desktop app that auto-detects a game's engine, extracts the text, translates it with local or cloud AI, and re-applies the patch. 20+ engines, 20+ AI providers, 11 UI languages. Free & source-available, single-player focused.

title: AA-Box/little-monkey
summary: Open-source local Agent OS for autonomous AI agents — run local or cloud models with real tools, persistent jobs, sandboxed execution, MCP, and inspectable permissions.
